title: Add Internet Identity admin login, music upload, countdown timer, and day/night toggle

requirements.text: Replace the existing password-based AdminUnlock screen with Internet Identity authentication. Only users whose principal is in a hardcoded or backend-stored admin principal allowlist can access the admin panel. Non-admin principals are shown an 'Access Denied' message after login. The AdminView must gate all admin sub-views behind this II-based check.

quotes: Admin panel — Internet Identity authentication required, with principal-based access control

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Admin' tab shows an Internet Identity login prompt instead of a password form
After II login, only principals on the admin allowlist can view the admin panel
Non-allowlisted principals see an 'Access Denied' message
Admin can log out and the panel returns to the login prompt
The useAdminAuth hook or AdminUnlock component is replaced/updated to use useInternetIdentity

requirements.text: Add a music upload feature to the AdminSettings panel. The admin can upload an audio file (e.g. MP3) which is stored in the backend as a blob. All users' clients fetch and play this track as background music. A play/pause toggle button is placed in the top-right corner of the top navigation bar and is visible to all users regardless of login state.

quotes: admin upload music everyone listen it only also through button turn it off
Admin can upload a background music track; all users can toggle it on/off with a play/pause button in the top-right corner

acceptanceCriteria: AdminSettings has a file input to upload an audio file; the file is saved to the backend
All users' clients automatically load and loop the uploaded track
A music play/pause button appears in the top-right corner of the top nav bar
Clicking the button toggles playback on/off for that user
If no music has been uploaded, the button is hidden or disabled
The existing useBackgroundMusic hook is wired to the backend-stored music URL

requirements.text: Implement a configurable countdown timer visible to all users. The admin can set a target duration or target datetime from the admin panel. The timer displays hours, minutes, and seconds counting down. The admin can also reset/set-back the timer to a new value at any time. The timer state (target time) is persisted in the backend so all users see the same countdown.

quotes: Countdown timer — Set a duration and reset/set it back, visible to users

acceptanceCriteria: A countdown timer (HH:MM:SS) is visible on the main UI for all users
Admin panel includes a form to set a new countdown duration or target datetime
Admin can reset or update the timer at any time
The countdown target is stored in the backend and fetched by all clients
When the timer reaches zero it displays '00:00:00' and does not go negative
The existing useCountdown hook is replaced or extended to use the backend-stored target time

requirements.text: Add a day/night (light/dark mode) toggle button to the top navigation bar. Clicking it switches the entire app between light and dark themes. The user's preference is persisted in localStorage. The toggle should use a sun/moon icon and be placed alongside other top-bar controls.

quotes: Day/Night toggle — Light/dark mode switch in the top navigation bar

acceptanceCriteria: A sun/moon icon button appears in the top navigation bar
Clicking the button toggles between light and dark themes app-wide
The selected theme is persisted in localStorage and restored on page reload
Both light and dark themes use the existing CSS custom properties defined in index.css
The toggle is visible and functional without any login

constraints: Internet Identity integration must use the existing useInternetIdentity hook at frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts — do not create a new auth provider
All immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui) must not be modified
All Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo as a single actor
Music files must be stored as blobs in the backend, not served from external URLs
nonGoals: General user authentication — II login is only for the admin panel
Multiple admin roles or granular permissions beyond a single admin allowlist
Volume control for background music (only play/pause toggle)
User-uploadable music — only the admin can upload tracks
Server-side theme persistence — localStorage is sufficient for the day/night preference
